seoTitle: How to Log Out of TradingView on Any Device
metaDescription: Learn how to securely log out of TradingView on desktop or browser, fix a missing logout option, and sign out from all devices for account security.
intro: Signing out properly matters if you're using TradingView on a shared or public device, but the logout option isn't always obvious. This guide covers how to log out on desktop and browser, what to do if the logout button seems to be missing, and how to sign out from all devices at once. It's aimed at anyone who wants to keep their TradingView account secure.

steps.heading: Open the profile menu
steps.body: Click on your profile icon or avatar in TradingView to open the account menu.

steps.heading: Click the logout option
steps.body: Locate and select the logout or sign out option from the dropdown menu to end your session.

steps.heading: Fix a missing logout button on browser
steps.body: If the logout option isn't visible, try refreshing the page or checking a different menu location, since layout can vary by browser or view.

steps.heading: Log out from all devices
steps.body: Use your account security settings to sign out of all active sessions if you suspect unauthorized access or are using a shared device.

steps.heading: Follow basic account security tips
steps.body: Always log out on shared or public devices, and consider enabling extra security features to protect your account.

faq.question: Why can't I find the logout button in TradingView?
faq.answer: The logout option is usually inside the profile menu, but if it's not appearing, try refreshing the page or checking your account settings directly.

faq.question: Does logging out on one device log me out everywhere?
faq.answer: No, logging out on one device typically only ends that specific session unless you use the option to log out of all devices.

faq.question: Is it safe to stay logged into TradingView on a public computer?
faq.answer: No, it's best practice to always log out on shared or public devices to prevent unauthorized access to your account.

faq.question: What should I do if I think someone else accessed my account?
faq.answer: Log out of all devices immediately through your account settings and consider updating your password for added security.
